lessons.title: Cyrillic, gender and first cases
lessons.objective: Recognize and use the grammatical forms taught in these examples.
lessons.explanation:
New words and phrases

Это книга. — This is a book.
Я читаю книгу. — I read a book.
У меня нет книги. — I do not have a book.
Я говорю о книге. — I talk about a book.
Я учу русский язык. — I learn Russian.
Это окно. — This is a window.

Russian uses Cyrillic; do not replace Russian letters with similar-looking Latin letters. Книга is feminine and стол masculine; окно is neuter. There are no articles. The present-tense equivalent of am/is/are is normally omitted: Я студент. Учить changes to учу after я. Я предпочёл бы замену, а не возврат денег. — I would prefer a replacement rather than a refund.

lessons.explanation:
Giving advice with reasons

Если ты хочешь улучшить свои навыки, тебе стоит заниматься понемногу каждый день. — If you want to improve, you should practise a little every day.
Лучше делать ошибки, чем ничего не говорить. — It is better to make mistakes than to say nothing.
Когда ты не понимаешь слово, попроси привести пример. — When you do not understand a word, ask for an example.
Тебе не нужно понимать всё, чтобы следить за разговором. — You do not need to understand everything to follow a conversation.

Стоит plus an infinitive gives advice. Чтобы introduces purpose. Не нужно means there is no need.

lessons.title: Explaining your opinion
lessons.objective: Connect sentences to present a view, contrast and conclusion.
lessons.explanation:
Explaining your opinion

По моему мнению, у работы из дома есть несколько преимуществ. — In my opinion, working from home has several advantages.
Например, ты не тратишь время на дорогу до работы. — For example, you do not spend time travelling to work.
С другой стороны, может быть труднее отделять работу от личной жизни. — On the other hand, it can be harder to separate work from personal life.
Поэтому я предпочёл бы работать в офисе два дня в неделю. — That is why I would prefer to work in the office two days a week.

По моему мнению introduces an opinion; с другой стороны gives a contrasting point; поэтому links a conclusion. Предпочёл is masculine, предпочла feminine.

lessons.title: Meet the Cyrillic letters
lessons.objective: Recognize six Russian letters and distinguish Е from Ё.
lessons.explanation:
Your new letters

М — the m sound
Т — the t sound
К — the k sound
Н — the n sound
Е — starts the word еда
Ё — two dots

Examples: мама (mum), там (there), кот (cat), нос (nose), еда (food), ёлка (fir tree). The audio buttons play the letter names.

exercises.prompt: Which letter makes the “m” sound?
exercises.explanation: М represents /m/, as in мама (mum).

exercises.prompt: Which letter makes the “t” sound?
exercises.explanation: Т represents /t/, as in там (there).

exercises.prompt: Which letter makes the “k” sound?
exercises.explanation: К represents /k/, as in кот (cat).

exercises.prompt: Which letter makes the “n” sound?
exercises.explanation: Н represents /n/, as in нос (nose). It looks like Latin H but sounds different.

exercises.explanation: М and м are the capital and lowercase forms of the same letter.
